metadata.name: Savings Tracker
metadata.description: A high-performance, standalone Windows desktop application for personal finance management, featuring multi-card bank ledgers with running balances, recurring subscription tracking with automated due-date catchup, savings plans with feasibility metrics, native Windows toast notifications, an interactive overview dashboard with visual charts, and multi-device cloud synchronization powered by Supabase (PostgREST + GoTrue Auth) with offline-first local persistence.

dependencies.dependency: Advanced UI controls including TableBuilder for spreadsheets
Immediate-mode 2D plotting library for trendlines and financial charts
JSON storage and REST payload serialization
Date and time arithmetic and calendar calculations
Standard operating system directory paths resolution
Idiomatic error handling and context propagation
Native Windows Runtime (WinRT) APIs for interactive OS toast notifications
HTTP/REST client with Rustls for secure TLS communication with Supabase endpoints on Windows

architecture.pattern: Immediate Mode GUI (IMGUI) + Offline-First Asynchronous Cloud Sync
architecture.overview: Built around an immediate-mode UI paradigm where state is rendered and updated synchronously on every frame. Local persistence to %APPDATA%\SavingsTracker\data.json is fast and atomic (write-to-temp-and-rename). Mutations trigger non-blocking asynchronous pushes to Supabase PostgREST. Incoming changes are pulled periodically (every 60s while focused, and immediately on window focus regain) and merged using last-write-wins conflict resolution by updated_at (server wins on exact ties). Soft-deletes propagate via deleted_at timestamps.

key_subsystems.subsystem: Silent, atomic JSON persistence to %APPDATA%\SavingsTracker\data.json using write-to-temp-and-rename semantics. Automatically guarantees that missing sync fields (id, updated_at, deleted_at, category defaults) are populated.

Dual-channel background worker (src/sync.rs) coordinating PostgREST HTTP operations. Maintains per-table watermarks (sync_watermarks.json), an offline retry queue (pending_sync.json), and exponential backoff (2s to 60s, max 10 retries). Implements last-write-wins conflict resolution and soft deletes (deleted_at).

GoTrue authentication manager (src/auth.rs) managing login, registration, and session token storage in session.json. Proactively refreshes access tokens when less than 5 minutes of validity remain, preventing sync disruption.
Chronological ordering and running balance computation with dynamic filtering (period, category, text search). Filters out soft-deleted records and updates timestamps on mutation.
Automated time-travel catchup: advances overdue subscriptions and posts matching Money Out transactions when app launches.
Surplus evaluation, income vs expense feasibility calculations, overspending deduction, and deadline monitoring.
Visual financial dashboard (src/ui/overview.rs) featuring 30-day net worth sparkline, 12-month projected subscription commitments, category spend breakdown, and active savings plan progress cards.
Dual-layer Windows notification pipeline (primary: Windows Runtime WinRT COM APIs; fallback: headless PowerShell script).
Embedded typography with Space Grotesk (headings), Inter (proportional body), and IBM Plex Mono (tabular monetary figures).

module.description: Calculates prorated monthly costs, advances billing cycles, and automatically catches up missed payment dates by recording Money Out transactions when the application launches. module.role: Supabase PostgreSQL Schema and Security Rules
module.description: Defines the database schema on Supabase mirroring local structs field-for-field. Creates cards, transactions, subscriptions, savings_plans, and categories tables. Installs automatic BEFORE UPDATE triggers to maintain updated_at, defines sync indexes on (user_id, updated_at), and enforces strict Row Level Security (RLS) policies isolating data by auth.uid() = user_id.

test_suite.name: Core Domain Tests
test_suite.description: Automated test suite verifying domain logic, formatting, and mathematical guarantees.

tests.test: Verifies comma grouping, whole/decimal formatting, and parse_pkr_input for Pakistani Rupee amounts.
Verifies chronological sequencing, backdated edits, and balance math starting from opening balance.
Verifies that exactly one opening balance anchor row is synthesized for any card.
Verifies date progression and prorated monthly expense calculations.
Verifies automatic catchup generation for overdue recurring subscriptions.
Verifies feasibility detection when targets exceed monthly income.
Verifies monthly spending against limits and net surplus calculation.
Verifies atomic disk writes, temp file cleanup, and data recovery.
Verifies custom font families, glyph availability, and table layout generation.
End-to-end integration test verifying opening balance persistence, backdating, and comma parsing.

test_suite.name: Cloud Sync Tests
test_suite.description: Verifies synchronization logic, conflict resolution, offline queue serialization, and token refresh rules.

tests.test: Verifies proactive session refresh triggers when less than 5 minutes of validity remain.
Verifies exponential backoff calculation: 2s base doubling up to 60s cap with 10 max retries.
Verifies that server wins when remote timestamp is newer or identical.
Verifies that local row wins when local updated_at is more recent than server.
Verifies that deleted_at timestamps propagate correctly and resolve deletions.
Verifies independent watermark tracking across all 5 domain tables.
Verifies offline queue persistence, addition, and removal from pending_sync.json.
Verifies custom billing cycle serialization (monthly, yearly, custom:N).
Verifies pre-sync data.json without UUIDs or timestamps auto-migrates cleanly.

test_suite.name: Redesign & Visual Analytics Tests
test_suite.description: Verifies visual dashboard calculations, category colors, savings pacing, and responsive UI scaling.

tests.test: Verifies 12-month commitment projection points and aggregate annual calculations.
Verifies on-track vs behind pacing calculations and projected completion dates.
Verifies deterministic color assignments across all budget categories.
Verifies headless UI layout stability across small, standard, and wide display resolutions.
